question: The average weight of 15 persons is increased by 1.2 kg when one of them whose weight is 51 kg is replaced by a new man. The weight of the new man is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of new person = Weight of replaced person + Total increase in weight

Total increase in weight = Increase in average × Total persons

Total increase in weight = 1.2 × 15 = 18 kg

Weight of new person = 51 + 18 = 69 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 69 kg.**
